استكشفن (form X)
# اِسْتَكْشَفْنَ (istakšafna) /is.tak.ʃaf.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# اُسْتُكْشِفْنَ (ustukšifna) /us.tuk.ʃif.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
# اِسْتَكْشِفْنَ (istakšifna) /is.tak.ʃif.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَكْشَفَ (istakšafa)
